title: Best Quartz Watch 2026: 5 watches tested for accuracy across 90 days
description: Seiko, Citizen Eco-Drive, Casio, Tissot, Swatch — 90 days measuring accuracy in sec/month, water exposure, battery vs solar tradeoffs. Sub-$500 only.
lede: Five sub-$500 quartz watches. 90 days of wear. We measured accuracy daily, pool-tested each, and computed 10-year ownership cost.
methodology: Time-synced to atomic clock daily, drift measured in seconds. Pool dives 30min/day for 7 days. 10-year cost = batteries + service + water-seal renewals.

sections.heading: Accuracy and 10-year cost
paragraphs: Citizen Eco-Drive: ±5 sec/month (solar-synced). Tissot PRX: ±10. Seiko 5: ±15. Casio Edifice: ±20. Swatch: ±25. All 10-100x more accurate than mechanicals at this price.
10-year cost: Citizen $80 (no batteries, one service). Tissot $150. Seiko $80. Casio $30. Swatch $30. Solar pays back by year 7 for daily wearers.

faqs.q: Quartz vs mechanical — which is better?
faqs.a: Quartz is 10-100x more accurate, no winding, costs less. Mechanical has heritage and craftsmanship. For timekeeping, quartz wins; for emotional connection, mechanical.

faqs.q: Solar vs battery — worth the premium?
faqs.a: Yes for daily wearers. The $200+ Eco-Drive pays back in saved batteries by year 7. For occasional wear, battery is cheaper because cells stay charged.

seiko-5-sports-quartz.review: Japanese workhorse at $150-220. 100m WR, day-date, 10+ year battery. Most reliable daily-driver.

citizen-eco-drive-corso.review: Solar-powered — no battery ever. Charges in any light. ±5 sec/month, sapphire crystal. Best long-term cost.

casio-edifice-efr-303d.review: Quartz chronograph at $80-140. 100m WR, 3-year battery, sporty 45mm. Best budget chronograph.

tissot-prx-quartz-35mm.review: Swiss quartz at $375. 1970s integrated bracelet design, 10-year battery, sapphire crystal.

swatch-once-again-gent.review: Plastic Swiss quartz at $70. 1983 design, 24g lightweight. Cheapest Swiss-made entry.

pinDescription: 5 quartz watches under $500 tested 90 days. Seiko vs Citizen Eco-Drive vs Casio vs Tissot vs Swatch. Accuracy, solar vs battery, 10-year cost. #watches #quartzwatch
